| g1_model | model | ticks | command_ticks | trigger_ticks |

Events (9): wake `Nova` @ t=9.92 s conf 1.0 and `Piattos` @ t=19.92 s conf 0.66; top command `PLAY_MUSIC` @ 9.92 s conf 0.9861; 5 sub-threshold probes (`LIGHT_ON`/`TIMER`/`ALARM`/`NEXT`, conf 0.37–0.49) correctly withheld at `threshold: 0.5`.

**Notes / caveats**
- Job API wraps its payload as `{"job": {...}}` — my first poll loop read top-level keys and reported `status=undefined`; that was a harness parsing bug, not an app failure. Raw payload confirmed terminal `done`.
- The POST response also uses the `{"job": {"id": ...}}` wrapper; job id was `9e004969c066` (not a top-level `job_id` field).
- A final read-only convenience command (`wc -l` on the job log) was denied by the shell permission policy as `external_directory`; no side effects, and results were already conclusive without it.
- No files or servers were modified; no start/stop actions taken.

**Overall: 5/5 PASS.** The Recording Test feature accepts a test request, executes the full 26-tick G1→G2 pass in ~0.3 s, exposes complete per-combo summaries and event traces, and the lab UI contains all five recording-frame controls.
